basis: Existing hotels in data/phase1/route-plan.json plus these hotels at existing landing beaches. Current hotel network applied equally to all historical weather years; openings and availability not modelled. Expanded network: 12 additional existing route beaches. Beach proximity refers to the named beach, not a surveyed walk from the model coordinate. No vehicle transfers assumed.
